name: architecture-sentinel
description: Evidence-backed architecture and security analysis for software repositories

scripts.build: npm run build -w @sentinel/schema && npm run build -w @sentinel/providers && npm run build -w @sentinel/ingestion && npm run build -w @sentinel/graph && npm run build -w @sentinel/analysis && npm run build -w @sentinel/web && npm run build -w @sentinel/cli && npm run build -w @sentinel/mcp
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @sentinel/schema && npm run build -w @sentinel/providers && npm run build -w @sentinel/ingestion && npm run build -w @sentinel/graph && npm run build -w @sentinel/analysis && npm run dev -w @sentinel/web
